test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3)** i.e. **‘collecting’.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• He spent nearly twenty years (3) _____the matter for his book, which was to deal with every known fact concerning the problem of the species.
 
 
• To write a book an author has to accumulate many findings for his book. 
 
• In this context** ‘collecting’ (संग्रह)** fits the best to fill in the blank. It means to bring or gather together.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct sentence is** Darwin planned to (1) ***write***__ a book describing his (2) ***__discoveries__***. He spent nearly twenty years (3) **__*collecting *__**the matter for his book, which was to deal with every known fact concerning the problem of the species. Unluckily for Darwin, a naturalist named Wallace had been (4) _____over the same problems and had reached the same solution. He sent Darwin an essay which almost word for word repeated Darwin's own ideas. Yet Wallace, who was an (5) ____, had been working far away in the Malay Archipelago, whilst Darwin had not left England for several years. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Making : (निर्माण) - **The process of making or producing something, not relevant here.
 
• **Observing : (अवलोकन) -** Notice or perceive (something) and register it as being significant, not suitable in this context.
 
• **Dispersing : (विकीर्ण करना) - **Distribute or spread over a wide area gives a completely different sense.

1b3:Td3e,

The correct answer is opt
